content_of_post_to_answer: Why can being too intelligent be very burdensome?
answer: Intelligence can become burdensome when the mind keeps seeing layers that others do not notice. The difficulty is not knowing more, but having fewer places to rest from constant analysis. A highly analytical person may mistake understanding a problem for being able to solve it, creating frustration with uncertainty and human complexity. The overlooked skill is not reducing intelligence, but learning when deeper thinking serves a purpose and when it only creates noise. A sharp mind needs boundaries as much as it needs curiosity.
